recent_skill_commits.message: Updatea all skills to lates API endpoints, packages and docs

fix(skills): make console diagnostics safe for cp1252

Fixes #292. Use readable ASCII status markers in 42 Python scripts across 20 skills, preserve figure and prompt text, keep copied validators/generators identical, and add static plus real-console regression coverage.

Validation: all 20 affected isolated skill suites and spec checks pass. PyMC required a process-local PYTENSOR_FLAGS=cxx=,linker=py,blas__ldflags= override because the native macOS linker could not find d64.

Update skill versions and enhance documentation across multiple skills

- Bumped version numbers for several skills: 13c-metabolic-flux to 1.1, adaptyv to 1.4, aeon to 1.2, alphagenome to 1.1, analytical-method-validation to 1.2, anndata to 1.3, arbor to 1.3, arboreto to 1.2, astropy to 1.4, autoskill to 1.5, benchling-integration to 1.6, bgpt-paper-search to 1.2, bids to 1.2, biopython to 1.4, bioservices to 1.5.
- Updated descriptions and compatibility notes for clarity and accuracy.
- Improved documentation for API endpoints and usage examples, ensuring users have the latest information for effective implementation.

Update version numbers and enhance skill documentation

- Bumped version in plugin.json and pyproject.toml to 2.66.0.
- Updated skill metadata versions across multiple skills, reflecting improvements and new features.
- Added citation guidelines to various skill documentation to ensure proper referencing of the "Scientific Agent Skills" paper.

Update review model to version 3.7 across multiple scripts

- Changed the review model from "google/gemini-3.6-flash" to "google/gemini-3.7-flash" in the following scripts:
  - generate_infographic_ai.py
  - generate_schematic_ai.py (in latex-posters, literature-review, scientific-schematics, and scientific-slides)
  - generate_slide_image_ai.py
- Updated documentation to reflect the new review model version in iterative_refinement.md.
